Robust to input edge (15.48 @0.5ps vs 15.02 @130ps) and to the window (0.3% over 400 ps). Brackets inside the campaign FO1@1.5V 9.87 and as-built 19.33 fJ/stage.

SUPERSEDED_2026_09_27_report_round.what_survives: the resonant gt/gtp pair alone: 2.974 fJ net, ledger closed to 1e-12, re-metered by a trapezoid path that never touches the 1F instrument (0.19%), transfer intact (EA_C -0.22%), all five gates PASS at the PRE-REGISTERED checkpoint tD=811.755 ps (this round used 556.8 ps -- procedural breach, immaterial to the verdict, and it widens the claimed adv window: adv=12 passes at the correct checkpoint).
SUPERSEDED_2026_09_27_report_round.still_unpaid_anywhere: sustaining amplifier (break-even eta_amp 35.1% at zero DC bias, 44.6% with the 2.71 fJ worst-case bias -- NOT the 27.7% this round quoted, which was computed against the park-free 5.273 fJ); the taps DC bias (Q_net 0.62/1.18 fC per cycle, a free-running LC cannot source net DC charge); the park phase generation; and the VHI 1.5 V pMOS-bulk rail at 4.31-4.49 fJ/hop, which appears in no committed ledger at all.
SUPERSEDED_2026_09_27_report_round.open_door: a RESONANT PARK TAP, unmeasured. At ~1.5 fJ E = 4.474 fJ, N_min 53.04, ADMITTED -- but the park must HOLD a DC level through the hold phase then cut, the one waveform a resonator is worst at.

_doc: GATE-CHARGE RECOVERY round (M1 resonant / M2 stepwise / M3 lower VGH) on the committed tg15p QAL transfer switch. Every row is a TEXT PATCH of swsweep/sw_tg15p_z.cir. Acceptance pre-registered in PRE_REGISTERED.json BEFORE the first recovery deck (mtimes in README).

reference.note: eta is quoted against the PRE-STATED 43.481 fJ so the handed-down threshold is not moved. The rectified charge integral shows a real conventional driver must move 35.5 fC/hop (53.27 fJ) because Miller re-supply while the switch conducts is charge the 29.0 fC one-way figure omits; using 53.27 would RAISE every eta, so 43.481 is the conservative choice. N_min is computed from E_drive directly, so no verdict depends on the denominator.

device_scaling_note: Ron*W and Cgate/W are size-invariant over 0.74-10 um (measured), so tau = Ron*Cgate is a single device constant: 1.884 ps for a 1:2 CMOS TG.

m1d_harmonic_nh5.note: steeper than the raised-cosine law because harmonic content raises dv/dt, hence I^2R.  Q here is the LUMPED equivalent of a multi-mode network, not a per-harmonic Q.

inductor.taps_needed: gt and gtp are anti-phase (a centre-tapped/differential pair is ONE structure) plus a ~12-24 ps phase ADVANCE on the gtp tap to satisfy the pMOS-cuts-early rule -> a poly-phase tap or a small passive shifter, not a second network.
inductor.inductor_count: 3-4 TOTAL for the whole chip, shared by ALL B banks (same order as the sigma0 arch already assumes for the rail).
inductor.B_invariance_PROVEN_algebraically: with B banks on one network the shared series R is R/B while C is B*C_net, so Q = 1/(omega*C_net*R) is B-INVARIANT; sharing buys a REALISABLE L (377 nH at B=1 -> 1.5 nH at B=256) without making Q harder.  This is what divides the per-bank tap cost by B and is the architectural prize.
inductor.ASSUMED_not_measured: the inductor is IDEAL in every deck; its ESR is folded into the swept series R.  No metal inductor Q is measured here.

The freeze switch is a B-INVARIANT recursion: its width must track the load it drives, so its gate charge tracks too and the per-bank cost does NOT amortise over B. analytic_best_case.assumptions: minimum-width (0.15/0.30 um) step switches, ideal tanks with no droop, no hold-switch Miller traffic -- i.e. strictly better than anything buildable.

m2_stepwise.scaling_law: residual/CV2 = 1/n + 2*alpha*tau*n^2/T_edge : the saving saturates as 1-1/n while the step-switch recursion grows as n^2 (count n, size n, because t_step = T_edge/n forces W ~ n).  With the MEASURED tau = 1.884 ps and T_edge <= 133 ps the optimum is n ~ 2 and the best possible recovery is ~10%.

CV2 scales ~V^1.86 (measured), so reaching 12.747 fJ by voltage alone needs VGH ~ 0.81 V, but completeness already fails at 1.20 V (VBEND out of band) and E_hop leaves its +-5% band at 1.35 V.  M3 alone ADMITS NOTHING.  Its honest role is a x0.84 MULTIPLIER at VGH=1.35 bought for a +5.8% E_hop penalty -- and that penalty is a real cost on the same ledger, so the multiplier is close to free-standing zero.
